decisions.reason: After four years and no later visibility, this bleaching-tray consumable looks like an option whose market test should already have resolved, so management would likely reallocate resources unless demand is clearly proven.
This PETG thermoforming blank remains very close to the firm's core dental materials portfolio and is likely inexpensive to carry, so keeping it is still defensible despite limited recent evidence.
Because it was only lightly featured at launch and then not observed later, this accessory appears to have revealed weak standalone value and is a natural candidate for exit.
Even with a good fit to digital and clinical workflows, the absence of visible follow-through after launch suggests the option has not developed strongly enough to justify continued support.
Custom earmolds fit the firm's hearing-care capabilities, specialist channels, and custom-manufacturing strengths so well that management would likely keep the line as part of the broader portfolio.
Hearing-protection earmolds use existing capabilities but serve a narrower niche, and with no stronger evidence of traction the firm would likely prune this line.
